title: Chapter 1268
text:
Also, there has been quite a storm recently. No matter what the outcome is, I have spent three years on this book, so naturally, I will finish what I started. You don't have to worry about me being affected by the recent events and quickly finishing it. I will definitely finish it as per normal.

PS: By the way, Witchcraft Lord, the author kills five birds with one stone. Fantasy farming, Lord nurturing, Witchcraft is the number one productivity.

Super Godly Mechanic, one day off.
